Foreign capital rotation away from US Treasuries

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Fed rate hike cycle and 5%+ 10Y yield
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten duration; favor floating-rate and short-duration bonds; increase equity hedges via put spreads

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy price spike and inflation resurgence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy equities; underweight fuel-intensive sectors (airlines, transport); add TIPS allocation

risk_assessment.risk_factor: US debt sustainability and foreign outflows
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify away from USD concentration; monitor foreign Treasury holdings monthly; consider gold and non-USD assets
Diversify AI exposure beyond single names; favor companies with diversified revenue; monitor antitrust enforcement
Avoid EM debt with currency mismatch; use credit default swaps on sovereign EM exposure

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing construction bottleneck and affordability crisis
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight long-duration REITs; favor construction and materials suppliers with pricing power

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Crypto regulatory uncertainty and exchange failures
risk_assessment.mitigation: Limit crypto allocation; favor regulated tokenization platforms (Robinhood) over unregulated exchanges

opportunities.recommendation: Add short-duration and floating-rate bond exposure
opportunities.rationale: 5% 10Y yield offers attractive carry; Fed signaling more hikes means short end will reprice higher, protecting short-duration holders

opportunities.recommendation: Selective AI/semiconductor positions on supply-constrained names
opportunities.rationale: Broadcom supply constraint, Intel/SK Hynix US manufacturing plans, and AMD 65% EPS compound through 2030 suggest structural demand outpacing supply

opportunities.recommendation: Value consumer staples with pricing power
opportunities.rationale: Kraft Heinz affordability strategy, Costco rival benefiting from bankruptcy; cost-conscious shoppers drive volume

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce long-duration bond and growth equity exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: 5% 10Y yield and hawkish Fed signal further repricing; growth multiples compress in rising rate environment

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge with gold and inflation-linked assets
defensive_moves.rationale: Gold swinging on Fed hawkishness but foreign Treasury outflows and debt concerns support long-term gold bid
United and American signaling capacity cuts due to fuel cost surge; margin compression likely through Q1 2027

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid unregulated crypto exchanges and high-beta EM debt
defensive_moves.rationale: CoinEx shutdown, Senate blocking crypto bill, Turkish fund default signal elevated tail risk in these segments

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce USD-only concentration; add multi-currency exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Foreign Treasury holdings at 9-month low; Rubenstein debt warning; Canada positioning as alternative hub

market_outlook.short_term: Markets face 2-3 week volatility window as Fed hawkish pivot digests. 10Y yield likely tests 5.2-5.4%. Equities under pressure from rate repricing and energy inflation. Energy and value outperform growth. Expect Dow to test lower support; Nasdaq more resilient on AI momentum. Crypto remains choppy post-Senate block.
market_outlook.long_term: If Fed continues hiking, 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive for quality equities with pricing power, energy, and healthcare. US debt trajectory (Rubenstein warning) and foreign outflows create structural headwind for USD assets. Canada and select EM markets offer diversification. AI remains structural growth theme but regulatory overhang caps multiples. Housing bottleneck supports construction/materials for 2+ years.
